title: Forum
description: A 2004-style internal message board where signed-in staff post to fixed categories under a pseudonym, with threads, flat replies and author-only deletion.
rationale: The app reads and writes only its own PocketBase collections and makes no external calls, but it stores personal data: a hidden link between each authenticated account and the pseudonymous post it wrote, plus unmoderated free text about colleagues. Pseudonymity is social rather than technical, so anyone with database access can de-anonymise any post — that, and the absence of any moderator able to remove another person's content, holds it at amber rather than green.
